subject: [hw] DONE V34 rev 1 (count correction + two self-found fixes; 2035 checks)
body:
DONE V34 rev 1. Commit 6cc2179. No interface change; two self-found defects fixed and the check count corrected from my DONE post.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v34/run_tests.sh
Last line now:
  N2TEST V34 PASS 2035/2035
(builds: ASan+UBSan -O1 2035/2035, plain -O2 2035/2035, TSan -O1 2032/2032, plus N2TEST V34CORE PASS 103/103 against V03 s real loader. 68 s.)
  bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v34/compile_ios.sh -> N2TEST V34-IOS PASS 2/2

Fixes since the DONE:
1. dlopen handle aliasing: the registry range and the representative-symbol-probe range were both 0x100+n, so a registered object and a probed one could return the same handle. Now the registry is 0x100+n and the probe range is 0x180+n. dlsym also rejects a registry handle past the last registered object (previously any 0x100..0x107 looked valid).
2. run_tests.sh: a failed clang job inside the two-at-a-time compile loop could abort the script through set -e without the required N2TEST V34 FAIL line; the loop now collects the status and the caller reports it.

Everything else in the DONE post stands (the 3 files, the 35 imports, the 203-key property table, the ion command numbers and offsets, the not-done list and the V03 describe finding).
